intro: Nauru is a parliamentary republic, one of the world's smallest.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament has 19 members, who elect the president. David Adeang became president in 2023.

chapters.title: Ties with Australia
text: Nauru hosts an Australian immigration centre and uses the Australian dollar.
